Aug. 2, 1923: Carbis Walker, a 26-year-old WWI veteran, becomes the first person to swim across Lake Erie. He makes the 32-mile transit from Point Pelee, Ontario, to Lorain, Ohio, in 20 hours, 15 minutes, eating only lumps of sugar tossed to him. He loses 20 pounds along the way.
